steps.label: score-values-db-1
steps.sql: SELECT spanner.score(spanner.tokenize_fulltext('cat cat dog'), 'cat') AS default_score, spanner.score(spanner.tokenize_fulltext('cat cat dog'), 'cat', options => '{"version": 1}'::jsonb) AS version1_score, spanner.score(spanner.tokenize_fulltext('cat cat dog'), 'cat', options => '{"version": 2}'::jsonb) AS version2_score

steps.label: score-values-db-2
steps.sql: SELECT spanner.score(spanner.tokenize_fulltext('cat cat dog'), 'cat') AS default_score, spanner.score(spanner.tokenize_fulltext('cat cat dog'), 'cat', options => '{"version": 1}'::jsonb) AS version1_score, spanner.score(spanner.tokenize_fulltext('cat cat dog'), 'cat', options => '{"version": 2}'::jsonb) AS version2_score

steps.label: bucket-pg-create
steps.sql: CREATE TABLE bucketdocs (id bigint NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, updatedat timestamptz NOT NULL, hourbucket bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM updatedat - '1970-01-01Z'::timestamptz)::bigint / 3600) STORED)

steps.label: bucket-pg-values
steps.sql: SELECT id, updatedat, hourbucket FROM bucketdocs ORDER BY id
